pgpr.reason: The strong 96-lane full-slice 1R1W output-stationary A1 reaches products/96. PGPR has the same exact products and destination commit lower bound.

p0_findings.finding: The analyzer does not require the frozen contract SHA/path/schema/status or the exact K3/S2/P1/OP1/dilation/group/bias/shape module population. It accepts any sealed payload-verifier directory with a generic PASS status, matching contract/capture hashes and 40 collapsed record keys, without pinning verifier code/schema, M511 runner SHA/final-attempt admission, claim boundary, or exact record-list uniqueness.
p0_findings.impact: A drifted or fabricated contract/capture/verifier tuple can publish an H67 exact-S10-labelled PASS even when the geometric premises and one-shot admission chain are not the reviewed generation.
p0_findings.required_fix: Pin contract e556... at its canonical path and validate all geometry/population fields. Pin the revised attempt-aware payload verifier SHA/schema and require its runner 788d.../final-attempt admission identity. Require raw record arrays to be exactly 40 with unique expected keys before dictionary construction.

p0_findings.finding: The analyzer writes/seals staging, atomically renames it to canonical, and only then verifies canonical. There is no prepublish staging verification, published transaction flag, quarantine, or canonical-absence postcondition on exception.
p0_findings.impact: A nonzero failed run can leave a canonical output directory that appears sealed or partially admissible.
p0_findings.required_fix: Verify staging before publish; precompute a unique absent quarantine; wrap publish/postverify in fail-closed exception handling; atomically move canonical to quarantine on any postpublish failure and assert canonical absence. Re-review the new SHA.

p1_findings.finding: The S10 decoder mean is added to the old S100 included-scope constant under mixed_cohort_corrected_envelope_sensitivity. Claim flags correctly forbid admission, but corrected_envelope is unsafe terminology.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Rename it to nonadmissible_s10_decoder_plus_s100_included_scope_sensitivity, record both cohort sizes, and forbid it from Amdahl/system tables.

p1_findings.finding: XOR/rise/fall product counts are exact, but no canonical-order finite-width output miter, weight scale, overflow proof, or state-SRAM cycle model exists.
p1_findings.disposition: Current no-RTL/no-system claim boundary is correct. If the ideal 1.30x gate survives, numeric miter and fully charged state model are mandatory before RTL.

decision.reason: The mathematical fast-kill is sound, but two fail-closed production-chain P0s remain. Supersede and statically re-review before any production payload run.
